text: Maaje ɗen ɗiɗi fotataa: gooto ngon, ko welngo ndiyam mun, newiingo yarde, sabu welgo ɗam, ɗiɗmo ngon, ko ndiyam lamɗam, haaɗuɗam, ɗam welaa yarde. Hiɗon ñaama e kala majje ɗiɗi, teewu keccu, woni liƴƴi, hiɗon yaltina kadi e majjam, kaŋŋe e kaalise, ko wattoɗon cuɗinoron. An ndaaroowo on, hiɗa yi'a laaɗe ɗen no awja doga, yaha rata, fii no ɗaɓɓiron arsike e ɓural Alla. Belajoo, on yettay Alla e ko O neemini on e mun kon fow.
